input.body:
Rate limits {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

{{ds:component/stat|value=1,000|label=requests / minute|description=Default rate limit for standard-tier API keys, per workspace.}}

Rate limit headers

Every response includes X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset. A request over the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header.

Pagination

List endpoints (Pipelines, Connectors, Events) use cursor-based pagination — a departure from v1's offset-based pagination.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-response.json|language=json|code={\n "data": [ { "id": "pl_ingest_orders" } ],\n "next_cursor": "eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ",\n "has_more": true\n}}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=

input.short_description: Standard-tier rate limits, quotas, and pagination for the v3 API.
input.body:
Rate limits {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}}

v3 is the current API version. v2 docs remain available for users still on the previous version.

Rate limits

Standard-tier accounts are rate-limited to 1,000 requests per minute per workspace. The remaining quota is returned in the X-RateLimit-Remaining response header.

Pagination

All list endpoints use cursor-based pagination. Responses include:

{{ds:component/code-block|language=json|code={\n "items": [...],\n "pagination": {\n "next_cursor": "abc123def456",\n "has_more": true\n }\n}}}

Pass the next_cursor to the cursor query parameter to fetch the next page. The page_size parameter (1–100, defaults to 20) controls results per page.

{{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Rate limits
  • Pagination
    • }}

input.short_description: Error response codes and details for the v3 API.
input.body:
Error reference {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}}

v3 is the current API version. v2 docs remain available for users still on the previous version.

Error responses

Errors are returned with a non-2xx status and include:

{{ds:component/code-block|language=json|code={\n "error": {\n "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",\n "message": "Request failed validation",\n "details": {\n "fields": {\n "name": "Pipeline name is required"\n }\n }\n }\n}}}

Common error codes:

  • VALIDATION_ERROR (400) — Request body failed validation
  • NOT_FOUND (404) — Resource does not exist
  • CONFLICT (409) — Resource already exists (e.g., duplicate pipeline name)
  • RATE_LIMITED (429) — Rate limit exceeded; retry after the Retry-After header
  • INTERNAL_ERROR (500) — Unexpected server error
{{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=

input.body:
Rate limits {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}}

v3 is the current API version. v2 docs remain available for users still on the previous version.

Rate limits

Standard-tier accounts are rate-limited to 1,000 requests per minute per workspace. The remaining quota is returned in the X-RateLimit-Remaining response header.

Pagination

All list endpoints use cursor-based pagination. Responses include:

{{ds:component/code-block|language=json|code={\n "items": [...],\n "pagination": {\n "next_cursor": "abc123def456",\n "has_more": true\n }\n}}}

Pass the next_cursor to the cursor query parameter to fetch the next page. The page_size parameter (1–100, defaults to 20) controls results per page.

input.short_description: Error response codes and details for the v3 API.
input.body:
Error reference {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}}

v3 is the current API version. v2 docs remain available for users still on the previous version.

Error responses

Errors are returned with a non-2xx status and include:

{{ds:component/code-block|language=json|code={\n "error": {\n "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",\n "message": "Request failed validation",\n "details": {\n "fields": {\n "name": "Pipeline name is required"\n }\n }\n }\n}}}

Common error codes:

  • VALIDATION_ERROR (400) — Request body failed validation
  • NOT_FOUND (404) — Resource does not exist
  • CONFLICT (409) — Resource already exists (e.g., duplicate pipeline name)
  • RATE_LIMITED (429) — Rate limit exceeded; retry after the Retry-After header
  • INTERNAL_ERROR (500) — Unexpected server error
{{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Error responses
    • }}
